notes.title: NEW DLC: "The Art and Secrets of Karambola"!
notes.content:
Celebrate with me the 8th, „round” anniversary of the original release of „Karambola”*!

I prepared a special art book filled with never-published-before illustrations, sketches, ideas and notes from the development process.

I’m sharing my thoughts on my peculiar little characters and inspirations behind the game. 

It’s a relaxing and hopefully inspiring read for all the fruit-heads out there!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42373429/fb1528d480a88a072d6438fdee9a8ee8dd686a83.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42373429/b393071601128138aa13124fd140aac76cd494e4.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42373429/1289a3fa1de0f89662aca49a702741131ac1343e.png

You can get it here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3172920/The_Art_and_Secrets_of_Karambola/

In other news, there is now also a Turkish translation prepared by the wonderful Pınar Ebru!

* ("Karambola" was first released precisely on September 7th, 2016, and then came to Steam in 2022.)

notes.title: New Translations: Spanish & Italian
notes.content:
You can now play Karambola in Italian and Spanish (both Spain and Latin America variants)!

This is only possible thanks to wonderful volunteers: Kotsure (vero.quinteros.c (at) gmail dot com) - for Spanish translations, and nicolas : todaro (nicolas.todaro (at) proton dot me) for Italian. Thank you both for reaching out!! <3 <3 <3

We also:
- improved playability on touch screens and gamepads
- made performance fixes
- fixed minor flower bug in the first scene

In other news, I am currently working on a stop-motion animation project about a crotchet owl; also, recently we made a small game called Rukavychka during the United with Ukraine Game Jam - you can check these out and more at https://www.instagram.com/holypangolin/ or https://mastodon.social/web/@holypangolin

Links to our games and other socials are here: https://linktr.ee/agata.nawrot

Thanks for reading!

Fruit-out!
Agata

notes.title: Avatars & Brazilian Portuguese translation!
notes.content:
You can now set your own avatar with characters from Karambola :) and play the game in Brazilian Portuguese! (Along with English, Simplified Chinese, Russian and Polish).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42373429/38b5045f6f2e3bccb7e56acec3c61b47ffb54647.png

You can choose your avatar from these 13 lucky designs in your Steam profile settings! Enjoy! If you have a favorite character that you'd like to see on avatar, let us know in the comments :) ❤️

When choosing an avatar, you have random 5 of them available, but just refresh the page to see the other ones!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42373429/b780a6fcc166eda4d897c927a0f47e39bd671d9f.png

PT-BR translation was added thanks to Isadora Souza, who liked the game and offered to translate it! 😍
I highly recommend her services, if you need a translation please write to: isadora (dot) bernadete (at) gmail (dot) com 

We also made a custom font to make future translations much easier! 🔥 The GNU/Linux version of the game has also received a couple of fixes to improve compatibility across various distributions and Steam Flatpak installations.

I also want to express gratitude for Very Positive reviews!!! Thank you so much!

Some of you wrote that they'd wish to pay for "Karambola". There are a couple of ways to support me:

- buy t-shirts and swag from our shops (I plan to update them soon!)
- pay for one of our choose-your-own-price games
- donate to my PayPal (I'll check out alternative ways of donations/patronage soon)
- follow our socials to know about new projects, merchandise or new ways to support me, and like/comment/share my posts to boost my dopamine & motivation <3 It all means a lot!

You can find all links here: https://linktr.ee/agata.nawrot

Your support, even small, would mean a lot and be a great help for me to keep working on new projects. Every bit helps!

Wish you a great week :)
Fruit-out!
Agata

notes.title: Karambola: Now on Steam!
notes.content:
The time has come... after 'only' 6 years, filled with sweat, tears and intense procrastination - emotional fruit-people and "Karambola" have finally arrived to Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42373429/4f46658c66e5508153da7dbebbfd2aefb3a83fd5.jpg

This is not a mere re-release, but a greatly improved build of the game, allowing you to experience:

- the ability to gather the cutest achievements!
- magical almost-HD shader for improved visual fidelity!
- gamepad and keyboard navigation!
- full Steam Deck support!
- countless fixes for minor bugs!
- Polish, Simplified Chinese and Russian translations!

I am now working on a new stop-motion project, please follow us on social media for teasers, behind the scenes and some never-posted old projects. Holy Pangolin makes not only indie games, but also animations, interactive objects, and handmade art.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/holypangolin/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCHt89DA7slYsAekgfAVG5UA
FB, Twitter, Mastodon and more links here: https://linktr.ee/agata.nawrot

See you there!
Agata <3
